lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdBi₂ crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31m (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Nd centers have 16 neighbors, and two Bi environments have 8 and 10 neighbors, respectively. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between 12-vertex Bi polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between 10-vertex and 16-vertex Bi and Nd coordination polyhedra.
